scripts.dev: bun run dev:prepare && nuxi dev playground
scripts.dev:build: cd playground && bun run prepare && nuxi build
scripts.dev:prepare: nuxt-module-build build --stub && nuxt-module-build prepare && nuxi prepare playground
scripts.release: bun run lint && bun run test && bun run prepack && changelogen --release && npm publish && git push --follow-tags
